The '''''Jewel of Churba''''' was a [[Dairkan Starliner]] inspired by the ''[[Queen of Empire]]''. It transported [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Erisi Dlarit]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] mission to disable the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] shields.
